decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper fits the firm's core construction-machinery line and has had only one year on the market, so results are still uncertain and existing slack lets management carry it while performance is judged against aspirations.
The articulated dumper is close to the established dumper business, so its cost of carrying is low and there is no evidence yet of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search or dropping it.

The underground mine rescue vehicle serves a niche with long sales cycles and is more distant from the core, which raises the risk somewhat, but one year is too short to judge it against aspirations, so management keeps it.
The compact telescopic loader faces strong competition, yet it complements the compact equipment range and remains featured on the website, so the firm keeps it while it builds market results.
